bit.prime_choice: Fixed odd q > 2^80 avoiding the finite rational denominator and rank-witness primes
bit.row_stock: O(w log e) internally borrowed radix-q digits, restored at the outer boundary

bit_uniform.external_stock: No q-adic group-size factor is inserted into the external polynomial row stock
bit_uniform.selector_stock: O(w log e) internal borrowed rows; restored by the uniform old-supplier wrapper

rows.contract: Finite complex group role stock plus conservative fixed legacy bit reserves; q-adic selectors borrowed internally and restored; one prefix and one padding; sequential reuse

semantic.exact_grid: One common dyadic grid times 21^(-K), K=G*(D_complex+1); no child rounding

scope: Exact local inventories, strict moments, contaminated fallback charge and semantic assembly. Local finite reconstruction is checked separately; group geometry, uniform weighted routing, borrowed rows and inherited analytic/tape contracts are written proof dependencies.
